Definition: Jeshua, son of Jozadak, the high priest
BiblicalUsage: In its Aramaic spelling, Jeshua is the name of the high priest who returned with Zerubbabel. In Ezra 5:2, Jeshua the son of Jozadak.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Jeshua is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
